about: J's standing decisions, his preferences, and how the studio works. Decisions here are J's own words from the projects map and his sessions.

entries.title: Going live is J's call: he types DEPLOY <product>
entries.body: Agents and Talk never push main or go live. Show studio_deploy_plan in plain words, then wait for the exact words. Rollbacks the same with ROLLBACK <product>. "Yes" or "ship it" are not enough.

entries.title: Talk's PM loop merges verified changes into beta without asking
entries.body: Delegated merges: a change that passes its acceptance gate goes into beta. Never live, never Studio or Gen (those are J's MERGE).

entries.title: At most 4 GPU servers, US regions only
entries.body: us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2 (cheapest). Launching, starting or terminating servers asks J first.

entries.title: Phone notifications only for what went wrong, J-only decisions and milestones
entries.body: Merges, starts, answers and progress go to Talk only.

entries.title: Reviews run on Sonnet
entries.body: STUDIO_REVIEW_MODEL; a review is a few cents. Keep them there.

entries.title: J doesn't review code: explain in plain words with evidence
entries.body: What was wrong, what changed, how it was verified, the verdict, with links (pull request, preview, video). Lead with the outcome.

entries.title: J's budget is tight: ask before spending
entries.body: Ask before big batches, GPU time, new servers or raising limits. The control server is a 4 GB t3.medium: keep services light.

entries.title: Be concise and direct
entries.body: Short lists, no filler. Ask when the decision is J's; decide details yourself.

entries.title: Content is data and the data is the source of truth
entries.body: Sick Of It: Assets/GameConfig/*.json. Dose Of Destruction: content/*.json. PH Origins: levels/, cutscenes/, locales/*.json. I Can Be: day.config.js. Most requests are data edits. Never hand-edit generated output (play/, dist/, Game/v*, Library/).

entries.title: Story doc first, then content
entries.body: Each product's story doc is the design document: read it before adding levels, enemies, characters or lines, and add to it before building something it doesn't explain.

entries.title: New generative work goes through Hawkes Gen
entries.body: Projects never hold AWS or API keys. Use presets (hawkesgen/presets/<project>.json) for art direction; if a tool is missing, add a workflow or tool in Gen.

entries.title: Every website is static on GitHub Pages
entries.body: No server code, no custom headers, no backend; each site has a CNAME. Docker, nginx or Flask files in a site repo are leftovers. Anything server-side must be client-side or a third-party service.

entries.title: Unity WebGL builds use .unityweb with the decompression fallback
entries.body: GitHub Pages doesn't send Content-Encoding. The page's loader must point at the current Game/v<n>/ file names.

entries.title: Playtest bots play through real input
entries.body: window.hawkesPlaytest (hawkesstudio/docs/playtest.md); Unity uses com.hawkes.playtest. No teleporting or state edits; named setup shortcuts are fine. Keep the bot working: studio.cmd playtest <product> smoke --wait.

entries.title: The lanes: agent branch, then beta, then main
entries.body: Agent pull requests target beta; <sub>.hawkesgen.com is beta; main is the live site. Studio and Gen have no beta: their main deploys to the cloud server once CI passes.

entries.title: Unity .meta files stay with their assets
entries.body: Never delete or move a .meta without its asset; never edit Library/, Temp/, obj/ by hand. Unity batch mode fails while the editor has the project open.

entries.title: Website repos must be checked out with autocrlf=false on the Windows build server
entries.body: Git for Windows checked them out as CRLF and go lives rewrote index.html whole. Gen's seedFromGit sets core.autocrlf=false for site roots; Unity projects keep CRLF (rewriting would reimport everything).
entries.tags: crlf autocrlf windows build server git

entries.title: Sick Of It's assets are in Git LFS: the build server's checkout needs the token
entries.body: The checkout downloads LFS files with the same GitHub token (hawkes/github). A failed checkout says "(Git LFS?)": check the token's Contents access before anything else.
entries.tags: git lfs build server sickofit token

entries.title: The first pages.yml on main needs the Pages source switched to GitHub Actions
entries.body: Studio does it (golive.ts PUT /pages build_type workflow) and dispatches the workflow; the push-triggered run is cancelled by the pages concurrency group, which is expected. If the token can't, J switches it in Settings > Pages.

entries.title: A hidden browser pane never fires requestAnimationFrame
entries.body: Contract bots then look stuck on the title screen. Use headless Playwright (hawkesgen/node_modules) or a visible page.

entries.title: Contract bots click with element.click(), so audio never unlocks
entries.body: Playtests then play in silence. To check sound, make one real page.mouse.click first.

entries.title: Shell heredocs mangle backslashes and Windows files can be CRLF
entries.body: In Git Bash, escaped quotes and \n inside heredocs are easy to break, and many files in these repos are CRLF in the working tree: exact-match edits fail. Use the editor tools or write the script to a file first; normalize line endings when matching.

entries.title: Studio restarting drops in-memory waits
entries.body: A self-deploy restart 32 s after a main push lost the pending live playtest (verifyLive) and the push entry. Long waits belong in runs or the database, resumed at startup.

entries.title: On the server, git as another user hits 'dubious ownership'
entries.body: /srv/hawkes repos belong to the hawkes user; run git as hawkes (sudo -u hawkes) or add safe.directory.
